title: Asymptotic construction-work bound
statement: For inputs to the almost-wise independent construction, let $s=\lceil nb/a\rceil$, where $a/b$ is the input bias. As $s$ tends to infinity over the admissible inputs, the total construction work is $O((s+1)^{16})$.
hypotheses_covered: the asymptotic comparison is along inputs whose scale $\lceil nb/a\rceil$ tends to infinity
caveat: The Lean statement uses a filter comapped from the input scale; the sentence paraphrases its asymptotic meaning.
